fixtures.name: monologue-20s
fixtures.transcript: Let me tell you about the long trip we took to the mountains last summer. We packed a red tent, two sleeping bags, a little stove, and far too many apples. The road climbed past a waterfall, a wooden bridge, and a field full of yellow flowers. At the top the wind was cold, so we made cocoa and watched the clouds roll below us. On the way home we found a bakery that sold cinnamon rolls bigger than my hand. I would go back tomorrow if the car were not still full of pine needles and sand.
